_readme: Source for the Work and Reels pages. After any change run: python tools/build_pages.py. Only write what is real: a field left out simply doesn't show. A page goes into Google once it has both what and why. Fields are listed in README.md.

projects.title: Logo animation: your logo, in motion
projects.summary: The Akdeinz Motion mark shown in three motion styles: build, fold and slide.
projects.what:
A 9-second logo animation. The mark is built from five bands cut at 60°, and three small previews show it in three motion styles: build, fold and slide.

It is a self-initiated piece made for the Akdeinz Motion studio. No client is shown.
projects.why: A logo sting is the shortest motion job, and a logo can move in more than one way. This piece shows the same mark in three styles, so you can see the difference before you choose.
projects.alt: White Akdeinz Motion logo on black above the line Your logo, in motion, with three small previews labelled build, fold and slide.

projects.title: Kinetic type: words that move people
projects.summary: A headline set in type that changes weight and width.
projects.what:
A 9-second kinetic type piece. The words Words that move people are set in type of different weights and widths, with the axis values shown underneath.

It is a self-initiated piece made for the Akdeinz Motion studio. No client is shown.
projects.why: Type alone can carry a social ad. This piece shows how changes in weight and width give a headline its rhythm.
projects.alt: The words Words that move people in large black and blue type on an off-white background, with weight and width values below.

projects.title: Product and UI animation: one scroll
projects.type: Spec piece: product and UI animation
projects.summary: An illustrative app screen walked through in one scroll.
projects.what:
A 9-second product and UI animation. An app dashboard with a weekly activity chart is shown, and a cursor reaches a blue Generate button.

The interface is illustrative and is not a real product. It is a self-initiated piece made for the Akdeinz Motion studio. No client is shown.
projects.why: Founders often need to explain software in a few seconds. This piece shows how a screen can be walked through without a voiceover.
projects.alt: A browser window with a dashboard, a line chart and a blue Generate button under the headline Explain your product in one scroll.

projects.title: Social scroll-stopper ad
projects.summary: A feed of grey placeholder cards is cut by a diagonal, and one card moves.
projects.what:
A 9-second social ad format. A feed of grey placeholder cards is cut by a 60° diagonal, and a black card marked Now in motion takes the other side of the frame.

It is a self-initiated piece made for the Akdeinz Motion studio. No client is shown.
projects.why: In a feed, a moving piece stands out from static ones. This piece makes that point in the format itself.
projects.alt: A grey feed of placeholder cards split by a diagonal, with a black card reading Now in motion and the line Motion gets watched.

projects.title: 3D motion: depth that sells
projects.summary: The mark in 3D on a blue field, with small floating cubes.
projects.what:
A 9-second 3D piece. The mark is built from 36 layers and rotated around its vertical axis, on a blue background with small cubes.

It is a self-initiated piece made for the Akdeinz Motion studio. No client is shown.
projects.why: Depth gives a flat logo weight. This piece shows how little 3D it takes to lift a mark.
projects.alt: A white three-dimensional AM mark on a blue field with floating cubes and the line Depth that sells.

projects.title: Data motion: numbers people actually watch
projects.summary: A monthly bar chart with an average line and three key figures.
projects.what:
A 9-second data animation. A bar chart by month has a blue average line, and three key figures sit under it: 63%, a trend line and 11,871 units.

All numbers are sample data made for this piece. It is a self-initiated piece made for the Akdeinz Motion studio. No client is shown.
projects.why: A table of numbers is rarely read. This piece shows how a chart can be set up so the key figure stands out.
projects.alt: A bar chart with a blue average line, a ring showing 63% and a total of 11,871 units on a cream background.

projects.title: Process explainer: how a film gets made
projects.summary: A timeline from brief to delivery, drawn like a film editor.
projects.what:
A 9-second process piece. A timeline with four steps, brief, board, motion and deliver, sits under a frame that shows the 16:9 format.

It is a self-initiated piece made for the Akdeinz Motion studio. No client is shown.
projects.why: Clients often ask what happens after they say yes. This piece shows the four steps in one clip.
projects.alt: A dark timeline with the steps brief, board, motion and deliver under the headline How a film gets made.

projects.title: Every format: one idea on every screen
projects.summary: One layout shown in 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16.
projects.what:
A 9-second piece about formats. A phone-shaped frame carries the mark, and four format labels sit under it: 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16.

It is a self-initiated piece made for the Akdeinz Motion studio. No client is shown.
projects.why: Each channel wants a different shape. Every Akdeinz Motion package includes 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 versions, and this piece shows why.
projects.alt: A phone-shaped frame with the Akdeinz Motion mark and four format labels under the headline One idea. Every screen.

projects.title: Generative motion: made, not templated
projects.summary: The mark made of about 1,400 particles on a blue glow.
projects.what:
A 9-second generative piece. The mark is made of about 1,400 particles, generated from a fixed seed so the result can be repeated.

It is a self-initiated piece made for the Akdeinz Motion studio. No client is shown.
projects.why: Template animations look like each other. This piece shows motion that is written for one mark.
projects.alt: A grey particle-textured AM mark on black with a blue glow under the headline Made, not templated.

projects.title: Social UI animation: a DM and a storyboard
projects.summary: A short chat that ends with a storyboard file, drawn as a phone interface.
projects.what:
A 9-second piece drawn as a chat window. A message about a launch in three weeks is followed by a storyboard file in the thread.

The chat is illustrative. No real people or brands are shown. It is a self-initiated piece made for the Akdeinz Motion studio. No client is shown.
projects.why: Most jobs begin with a short message. This piece shows how that first message leads to a storyboard.
projects.alt: A dark chat window from Akdeinz Motion showing messages about a launch and a storyboard file under the headline Your next launch starts with a DM.

projects.title: Rise study
projects.summary: The logo sting. Bands slide in on their own axis, the fold fades up, then everything exits.

projects.title: Shutter study
projects.summary: Thin 60° slats breathing in width, like a shutter.

projects.title: Wave study
projects.summary: Rows of bands whose height follows a Mediterranean swell.

projects.title: Fold study
projects.summary: A ribbon pulled through a frame. Past the edge it bends into the fold.

projects.title: Stack study
projects.summary: Bars stack upward, then clear. The mark climbs.

projects.title: Tunnel study
projects.summary: Nested bands receding into the frame.

projects.title: Logo sting
projects.summary: The Akdeinz Motion mark: an A and an M joined into one form, built from bands cut at 60°.
projects.alt: White Akdeinz Motion logo animating in on a black background, with the tagline Movement, framed with intent, and a blue band.

projects.title: Movement, framed with intent
projects.summary: Bands rising on a single 60° axis, the motion system behind the Akdeinz Motion identity.
projects.alt: White, grey and blue parallelogram bands rising diagonally across a black background above the words Movement, framed with intent.

projects.title: Sharp coastlines, waves, sun on water
projects.summary: The Mediterranean, kept abstract and geometric. A study in 60° bands.
projects.alt: Rows of white and blue slanted bands rising and falling like waves on a black background.

projects.title: Move on the 60° axis
projects.summary: Bands enter and exit along their own diagonal. A motion principle of the identity.
projects.alt: White and blue slanted bands widening and narrowing in a wave on a black background, above the words Move on the 60° axis.

projects.title: Reveal with the fold
projects.summary: Where the bands overlap, a soft fold catches the light, like film or ribbon pulled through a frame.
projects.alt: White bands sliding across a dark frame and turning light grey where they fold at an edge, above the words Reveal with the fold.

projects.title: One easing
projects.summary: Every Akdeinz Motion animation uses one curve: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1).
projects.alt: Six slanted bands sliding in one after another, holding, then sliding out, above the words One easing.

projects.title: Rises on 60° and climbs
projects.summary: Akdeinz Motion rises on 60° and climbs: slanted bars stacking upward, the top one blue.
projects.alt: Slanted white bars stacking upward like a staircase, the top one blue, above the words Rises on 60° and climbs.

projects.title: Flat geometry. Angled cuts. No ornament.
projects.summary: The Akdeinz Motion identity: flat geometry, angled cuts, no gradients, no ornament.
projects.alt: Nested black and white slanted shapes moving into the frame like a tunnel, above the words Flat geometry, angled cuts, no ornament.
